title: Administration
notAllowed: This area is for staff, in a session with two-step verification.

create.title: Add a membership
create.intro: For an existing account without a membership, including honorary members. It runs until the end of the current year.
create.identifierHint: Only for types that need one. Digits only.

member.title: Membership
member.numberOnFile: Certificate or licence number on file

institutions.title: Hospitals and directors
institutions.intro: Hospitals, their departments and department directors. Directors review membership applications from their department and must use two-step verification.
institutions.noDirectors: No director yet: applications go straight to the organisation’s office, flagged.

import.title: Import members
import.intro: Upload a CSV file exported from the organisation’s records. First a dry run shows what would happen, without changing anything. Then apply it.
import.columns: Required: email, first_name, last_name, membership_type. Optional: identifier, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), payment_status, locale (he or en). The first row names the columns.
import.newAccounts: People without an account get one, and an email to set their password (valid for 7 days).

reasons.duplicateEmail: Email appears twice in the file
reasons.duplicateIdentifier: Number appears twice in the file
reasons.invalidLocale: Language must be he or en

fileErrors.noRows: The file has a header row but no members.
fileErrors.tooManyRows: The file has more than 5,000 rows. Please split it.
fileErrors.unterminatedQuote: A quoted value is not closed (line {line}).
fileErrors.quoteInField: A quote appears in the middle of a value (line {line}).

demoOutbox.title: Emails the demo sent
demoOutbox.intro: The demo sends no real email. What it would send (a sign-up's confirmation, a password reset) is kept here, so its links can be followed. Opening an email is recorded in the audit log, because its links act for the person it was sent to.
demoOutbox.notAvailable: There are no demo emails here: the site sends real email.
demoOutbox.subject: Subject
demoOutbox.links: Links to the site in this email
demoOutbox.noLinks: This email has no link to the site.
